settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Orders in metro cities are typically delivered in 2-4 business days. For the rest of India, delivery takes 4-7 business days. You will receive real-time tracking updates via SMS and email.

settings.question: What is your return & exchange policy?
settings.answer: We offer a hassle-free 7-day return and exchange policy from the date of delivery. If you are not satisfied with your purchase, you can request a doorstep pickup through our returns portal.

settings.question: Are all products 100% genuine and authentic?
settings.answer: Yes! Every item sold on Kartzo is guaranteed 100% authentic, sourced directly from authorized brand distributors and manufacturers, complete with manufacturer warranty.

settings.question: What payment methods are supported?
settings.answer: We accept all major UPI apps (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), Credit & Debit cards (Visa, MasterCard, RuPay), Net Banking across 50+ banks, and Cash on Delivery (COD).

settings.question: How can I track my shipment?
settings.answer: Once your order ships, an AWB tracking number is emailed and sent via SMS. You can also paste your tracking ID into our Track Your Parcel page for real-time live location updates.
